statement: A running model, not a calibrated one, and thinner than the wisteria model it is derived from: there was no prototype of this plant to carry numbers over from, so most are copied from wisteria or are placeholders. None has been measured on a plant. Use its output to compare scenarios and to show what a design implies, not to predict dates, sizes or loads.

phenology.budburstDoy.basis: Not bud break: the day from which a plant set out in mid May is taken to grow. RHS: replant in late spring once the risk of frost has passed.

phenology.growthEndDoy.basis: Taken to grow on until the nights turn cold in mid October. No dated source.

phenology.leafFlushDoy.basis: Leaves open as the shoots extend. A placeholder.

phenology.autumnColourDoy.basis: Not autumn colour: the plant yellows as the cold takes it. A placeholder.

phenology.leafFallDoy.basis: Not leaf fall: the plant is killed by the cold, taken as the first week of November. It is hardy only to 5 degrees (RHS H1c); the date is a placeholder and in a real year is whenever the first frost comes.

phenology.floralInitiationDoy.basis: Flowers on the growth of the year; buds are taken to form from mid June. No dated source.

phenology.flowerOpenDoy.basis: Flowers open in succession from summer to autumn (RHS): 1 July to 7 October.

phenology.petalFallDoy.basis: Placed inside the RHS flowering envelope of June to August (1 to 31 August).

phenology.flowerLastsDays.basis: How long one flower lasts. A placeholder.

extension.leaderMPerSeason.basis: RHS: 1.5 to 2.5 m, reached within the year or two. Grown as an annual it makes that in one summer; the figure within the band is a placeholder.

extension.lateralMPerSeasonByOrder.basis: Scaled down from the leader rate. Not measured.

extension.whipMPerSeason.basis: Every year the old stems throw new side shoots, which is where an established plant makes its leaves and flowers once the framework has stopped extending. Rate is a placeholder.

extension.establishmentFactorByYear.basis: No slow first year: its first year is its only year.

architecture.trunkStemStartYears.basis: Three stems from the base of a pot-grown plant. A placeholder.

architecture.nurseryCaneM.basis: Set out as a small pot plant. Not measured.

architecture.leaderLengthM.basis: The RHS ultimate-size band used as a cap on stem length. A height band is not a route length.

architecture.lateralLengthMByOrder.basis: Scaled down from the leader. Not measured.

architecture.lateralLengthSpread.basis: Copied from the Wisteria sinensis model for want of anything better. Not a measurement or a description of this plant.

architecture.lateralChanceByParentOrder.basis: Copied from the Wisteria sinensis model for want of anything better. Not a measurement or a description of this plant.

architecture.budExtraDormancyChance.basis: Buds do not wait a year: there is no second year.

attachment.maxGraspDiameterMm.basis: No measurement exists. A thin herbaceous twiner, taken to hold canes, laths and cables and nothing as stout as the timber here.

attachment.minPitchM.basis: Copied from the Wisteria sinensis model for want of anything better. Not a measurement or a description of this plant.

attachment.pitchPerCircumference.basis: Copied from the Wisteria sinensis model for want of anything better. Not a measurement or a description of this plant.

organs.leafLengthM.basis: Of the order given in descriptions. Not checked against a source here.

organs.leavesPerNode.basis: Honeysuckles bear their leaves in opposite pairs. A character of the family, not sourced here.

organs.spurChance.basis: No spurs: no wood lasts long enough to bear them.

organs.spurLengthM.basis: Short leafy side shoots. A placeholder.

organs.spurLeafCount.basis: No spurs are modelled for this plant.

organs.racemeLengthM.basis: Width of a single flower. A placeholder.

organs.whipShareOfNodes.basis: No side shoots from old stems: there are no old stems.

organs.whipsPerYearMax.basis: No side shoots from old stems: there are no old stems.

organs.whipLengthM.basis: Length of a year’s side shoot. A placeholder.

organs.leafLifespanYears.basis: Evergreen where it is warm enough (RHS); outdoors in the UK its leaves last the one summer.

flowering.competenceYears.basis: Flowers in the summer it is planted.

flowering.spurFloralChance.basis: Not applicable to this plant; present because every model carries every parameter.

flowering.unprunedFactor.basis: Not applicable to this plant; present because every model carries every parameter.

flowering.currentSeasonFlowersPerM.basis: Flowers per metre of the growth of the year, over the whole season. A placeholder.

flowering.currentSeasonMinShootM.basis: A shoot shorter than this is taken not to flower. A placeholder.
